name: Sylius
description: Symfony-based open source e-commerce platform for building custom online stores.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_URL: "mysql://sylius:{{env.MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-mysql:3306/sylius"
      APP_SECRET: {{env.APP_SECRET}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/media:/srv/sylius/public/media
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-mysql
  {{serviceName}}-mysql:
    image: mysql:8
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mysql
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: sylius
      MYSQL_USER: sylius
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mysql:/var/lib/mysql
